title: Input command
description: The sim's only input: one command per tick. All values are integers so commands replay exactly. Used by the game, scenarios, and demos.

yaw.description: Absolute view yaw in angle units, 65536 per full turn. 0 faces +x (east), 16384 faces +y (north); increases counterclockwise seen from above.

pitch.description: Absolute view pitch in angle units, 65536 per full turn. Positive looks up; 16384 is straight up.

forward.description: Forward (+) or back (-) movement; 127 is full speed.

side.description: Right (+) or left (-) movement; 127 is full speed.

buttons.description: Bitfield of held buttons: 1 = attack, 2 = jump.

weapon.description: Weapon slot to switch to this tick, or 0 for no change. Slots are defined in data/weapons.json.
